Feature: Todo Management
  As a user
  I want to create, complete, edit, and delete todo items
  So that I can track my tasks

  Background:
    Given the todo app is loaded with a fresh localStorage

  Rule: No todos state

  Scenario: Main and footer are hidden when there are no todos
    Given the app has no todos
    Then the "#main" section is not visible
    And the "#footer" section is not visible

  Rule: Creating a new todo

  Scenario: Create a new todo by pressing Enter
    Given the input field is focused
    When I type "Buy groceries" into the new-todo input and press Enter
    Then a new todo item with title "Buy groceries" appears in the list
    And the new-todo input is cleared
    And the "#main" section is visible
    And the "#footer" section is visible

  Scenario: Creating a todo with only whitespace does nothing
    Given the app has no todos
    When I type "   " into the new-todo input and press Enter
    Then no new todo item is created
    And the "#main" section is not visible

  Rule: Completing a todo

  Scenario: Mark a todo as complete
    Given a todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    When I click the toggle checkbox on "Buy groceries"
    Then the "Buy groceries" item has the "completed" class
    And the toggle checkbox on "Buy groceries" is checked

  Scenario: Unmark a completed todo
    Given a completed todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    When I click the toggle checkbox on "Buy groceries"
    Then the "Buy groceries" item does not have the "completed" class
    And the toggle checkbox on "Buy groceries" is not checked

  Rule: Mark all as complete

  Scenario: Toggle all marks every todo complete
    Given todo items "Buy groceries" and "Walk dog" and "Write code" exist
    When I click the "toggle-all" checkbox
    Then all todo items have the "completed" class
    And the "toggle-all" checkbox is checked

  Scenario: Toggle all marks every todo active when all are complete
    Given all todo items are completed
    When I click the "toggle-all" checkbox
    Then no todo item has the "completed" class
    And the "toggle-all" checkbox is not checked

  Scenario: Toggle-all checkbox updates when individual items change
    Given todo items "Buy groceries" and "Walk dog" exist
    When I mark "Buy groceries" as completed
    Then the "toggle-all" checkbox is not checked
    When I mark "Walk dog" as completed
    Then the "toggle-all" checkbox is checked

  Scenario: Clear completed removes all completed todos
    Given completed todo items "Buy groceries" and "Walk dog" exist
    And an active todo item "Write code" exists
    When I click the "Clear completed" button
    Then the todo "Buy groceries" does not exist in the list
    And the todo "Walk dog" does not exist in the list
    And the todo "Write code" still exists in the list

  Scenario: Clear completed button is hidden when there are no completed todos
    Given an active todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    Then the "Clear completed" button is not visible

  Scenario: Clear completed button is visible when there are completed todos
    Given a completed todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    Then the "Clear completed" button is visible

  Rule: Editing a todo

  Scenario: Double-click a todo label enters edit mode
    Given a todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    When I double-click the label of "Buy groceries"
    Then the "Buy groceries" list item has the "editing" class
    And the edit input contains "Buy groceries"

  Scenario: Save an edited todo on Enter
    Given the todo "Buy groceries" is being edited
    When I change the edit input to "Buy milk" and press Enter
    Then the todo label shows "Buy milk"
    And the "Buy groceries" list item does not have the "editing" class

  Scenario: Save an edited todo on blur
    Given the todo "Buy groceries" is being edited
    When I change the edit input to "Buy milk" and press Tab to blur
    Then the todo label shows "Buy milk"
    And the "Buy groceries" list item does not have the "editing" class

  Scenario: Delete a todo when edit input is empty
    Given a todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    And the todo "Buy groceries" is being edited
    When I clear the edit input and press Enter
    Then the todo "Buy groceries" does not exist in the list

  Scenario: Cancel editing with Escape restores the original title
    Given a todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    And the todo "Buy groceries" is being edited
    When I change the edit input to "Buy milk" and press Escape
    Then the todo label still shows "Buy groceries"
    And the "Buy groceries" list item does not have the "editing" class

  Rule: Deleting a todo

  Scenario: Click the destroy button removes a todo
    Given a todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    When I click the destroy button on "Buy groceries"
    Then the todo "Buy groceries" does not exist in the list

  Rule: Active todo counter

  Scenario: Counter shows number of active todos
    Given todo items "Buy groceries" and "Walk dog" exist
    And "Walk dog" is completed
    Then the todo-count element shows "1 item left"

  Scenario: Counter uses plural form for zero items
    Given all todo items are completed
    Then the todo-count element shows "0 items left"

  Scenario: Counter uses plural form for multiple items
    Given active todo items "Buy groceries" and "Walk dog" exist
    Then the todo-count element shows "2 items left"

  Rule: Persistence

  Scenario: Todos persist across page reload
    Given a todo item "Buy groceries" exists
    When the page is reloaded
    Then the todo "Buy groceries" still exists in the list

  Scenario: Completed state persists across page reload
    Given a completed todo item "Walk dog" exists
    When the page is reloaded
    Then the todo "Walk dog" has the "completed" class

  Scenario: Editing state is not persisted across reload
    Given the todo "Buy groceries" is being edited
    When the page is reloaded
    Then no list item has the "editing" class

Feature: Todo Filtering
  As a user
  I want to filter todos by their completion state
  So that I can focus on active or completed tasks

  Background:
    Given the todo app is loaded with a fresh localStorage
    And todo items "Buy groceries" and "Walk dog" and "Write code" exist
    And "Walk dog" is completed

  Rule: Default route

  Scenario: Default route shows all todos
    Given the app is at route "#/"
    Then all three todo items are visible in the list

  Rule: Active filter

  Scenario: Active route shows only incomplete todos
    Given the app is at route "#/active"
    Then the todo "Buy groceries" is visible in the list
    And the todo "Write code" is visible in the list
    And the todo "Walk dog" is not visible in the list

  Scenario: Marking a todo complete hides it in the active filter
    Given the app is at route "#/active"
    When I mark "Buy groceries" as completed
    Then the todo "Buy groceries" is not visible in the list

  Scenario: Unmarking a todo shows it in the active filter
    Given the app is at route "#/active"
    And "Walk dog" is visible under the completed filter
    When I unmark "Walk dog"
    Then the todo "Walk dog" is visible in the list

  Rule: Completed filter

  Scenario: Completed route shows only completed todos
    Given the app is at route "#/completed"
    Then the todo "Walk dog" is visible in the list
    And the todo "Buy groceries" is not visible in the list
    And the todo "Write code" is not visible in the list

  Rule: Filter link selection

  Scenario: Selected class is applied to the current filter link
    Given the app is at route "#/"
    Then the "All" filter link has the "selected" class
    And the "Active" filter link does not have the "selected" class
    And the "Completed" filter link does not have the "selected" class

  Scenario: Selected class moves when navigating to a different filter
    Given the app is at route "#/"
    When I navigate to route "#/active"
    Then the "Active" filter link has the "selected" class
    And the "All" filter link does not have the "selected" class

  Rule: Filter persistence

  Scenario: Active filter persists across page reload
    Given the app is at route "#/active"
    When the page is reloaded
    Then the app is still at route "#/active"
    And only active todos are visible in the list

  Rule: Routing and state changes

  Scenario: Clearing a todo updates the list in filtered view
    Given the app is at route "#/active"
    And only active todos are visible
    When I create a new todo "Read a book"
    Then the new todo "Read a book" appears in the list

# Application Specification

We have created this short spec to help you create awesome and consistent todo apps. Make sure to not only read it but to understand it as well.

## Template Application

Our [template](https://github.com/tastejs/todomvc-app-template/) should be used as the base when implementing a todo app. Before implementing, we recommend that you interact with some of the other apps to see how they're built and how they behave. Check out the [Backbone app](http://todomvc.com/examples/backbone/dist) if you need a reference implementation. If something is unclear or could be improved, [let us know](https://github.com/tastejs/todomvc/issues).

## Structure

### Directory Structure

Recommended file structure:

```
index.html
package.json
```

## Functionality

### No todos

When there are no todos, `#main` and `#footer` should be hidden.

### New todo

New todos are entered in the input at the top of the app. The input element should be focused when the page is loaded, preferably by using the `autofocus` input attribute. Pressing Enter creates the todo, appends it to the todo list, and clears the input. Make sure to `.trim()` the input and then check that it's not empty before creating a new todo.

### Mark all as complete

This checkbox toggles all the todos to the same state as itself. Make sure to clear the checked state after the "Clear completed" button is clicked. The "Mark all as complete" checkbox should also be updated when single todo items are checked/unchecked. Eg. When all the todos are checked it should also get checked.

### Item

A todo item has three possible interactions:

1. Clicking the checkbox marks the todo as complete by updating its `completed` value and toggling the class `completed` on its parent `<li>`

2. Double-clicking the `<label>` activates editing mode, by toggling the `.editing` class on its `<li>`

3. Hovering over the todo shows the remove button (`.destroy`)

### Editing

When editing mode is activated it will hide the other controls and bring forward an input that contains the todo title, which should be focused (`.focus()`). The edit should be saved on both blur and enter, and the `editing` class should be removed. Make sure to `.trim()` the input and then check that it's not empty. If it's empty the todo should instead be destroyed. If escape is pressed during the edit, the edit state should be left and any changes be discarded.

### Counter

Displays the number of active todos in a pluralized form. Make sure the number is wrapped by a `<strong>` tag. Also make sure to pluralize the `item` word correctly: `0 items`, `1 item`, `2 items`. Example: **2** items left

### Clear completed button

Removes completed todos when clicked. Should be hidden when there are no completed todos.

### Persistence

Your app should dynamically persist the todos to localStorage. If the framework has capabilities for persisting data (e.g. Backbone.sync), use that. Otherwise, use vanilla localStorage. If possible, use the keys `id`, `title`, `completed` for each item. Make sure to use this format for the localStorage name: `todos-[framework]`. Editing mode should not be persisted.

### Routing

Routing is required for all implementations. If supported by the framework, use its built-in capabilities. Otherwise, use the  [Flatiron Director](https://github.com/flatiron/director) routing library located in the `/assets` folder. The following routes should be implemented: `#/` (all - default), `#/active` and `#/completed` (`#!/` is also allowed). When the route changes, the todo list should be filtered on a model level and the `selected` class on the filter links should be toggled. When an item is updated while in a filtered state, it should be updated accordingly. E.g. if the filter is `Active` and the item is checked, it should be hidden. Make sure the active filter is persisted on reload.
